provenance.existing: Existing generated art from earlier Jade UI work, inspected in Phase03; do not attribute its generation to this phase.
provenance.toolPlan: Future illustrative raster jobs use built-in image_gen; utility glyphs use deterministic geometry/vector authoring; no CLI/API fallback requested.

generationPolicy.referenceHandling: View local source before any future edit; current images are style references only.
generationPolicy.saveFinalAssets: Future approved outputs copied into workspace Assets path before being referenced; retain current .meta GUIDs.
generationPolicy.actualDimensions: Generator may return different dimensions; record actual size, inspect alpha, then non-destructively prepare exact native export and update borders. Current targets do not assert files exist.

styleGuide.material: dark carved nephrite; antique brushed gold; quiet stone grain
styleGuide.light: top-left45degree warm key, subtle cool rim, no conflicting glows
styleGuide.texture: <=4 percent luminance variation in text centers,<=8percent decorative header opacity
styleGuide.composition: 80 percent visual quiet; max20percent decorative emphasis outside reading area, treat as art direction not measured pixel quota
styleGuide.iconScale: one primary silhouette; optional one accent; stable optical bounds
forbidden: multiple saturated rainbow accents per panel
thin ornate linework on tiny controls

icon.compression: platform trial and visual QA before choosing; no imports performed

frame.compression: thin-edge QA at native and360logical scale required

existingAtlas.note: 16 subSprites;7 have non-zero borders, Divider is Simple; do not regenerate or evenly reslice 4x4 by assumption.

background.presentation: cover/crop preserving aspect; avoid stretching; evaluate moon/cultivator safe crop on tall screen

usage: main-menu full bleed; do not cover live combat with this image
shared source atlas; keep existing GUID

releaseGates: No new image file exists for PLANNED entries until generation and QA complete.

Run texture-level text contrast over darkest/brightest areas; token contrast alone is insufficient.
All generated assets need saved prompt,tool/model info when available,timestamp,actual dimensions,SHA256,QA disposition and project path.
